items.question: How do I remove text from image online?
items.answer: Upload a supported image, continue with Google, start processing, review the result, and download it if it meets your needs.

items.question: Can I remove text from an image online for free?
items.answer: Yes. WatermarkGemini lets you remove text from images online for free. You can upload JPG, PNG, or WEBP images up to 10 MB and process them directly in your browser.

items.question: Can AI remove text from an image?
items.answer: Yes. AI can help identify and clean unwanted text areas while preserving the surrounding visual details. Results can vary depending on the size of the text and the complexity of the image background.

items.question: Can I remove unwanted text without damaging the background?
items.answer: WatermarkGemini is designed to remove unwanted text while keeping the surrounding image as natural as possible. Complex textures or text covering detailed objects may produce different results, so always preview the processed image before downloading.

items.question: What kinds of text can I remove from a picture?
items.answer: You can use WatermarkGemini to clean captions, date stamps, labels, annotations, text overlays, promotional copy, and other unwanted text from pictures you own or have permission to edit.

items.question: What image formats does WatermarkGemini support?
items.answer: You can upload one JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB.

items.question: Do I need to sign in to remove text from an image?
items.answer: Yes. You can choose an image before signing in, but Google sign-in is required before processing starts.

items.question: How long are my uploaded images stored?
items.answer: Uploaded images, processed results, and related processing records are designed to expire after 24 hours. Temporary download links expire sooner.

items.question: Can I remove text from multiple images at once?
items.answer: Not currently. WatermarkGemini processes one image at a time.
